categories.name: It works
categories.notes: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors; the 10 warnings are the scaffold's NU190x SixLabors.ImageSharp advisories, none introduced by the model. / returns 200 via the '/' (en-US) domain on the 'MCP Blog' front page under WWW, and lists both posts as cards with a cropped listing image, date, title and excerpt; the links work. Both posts render all 4 blocks (rich text, image with caption, rich text, quote) with no render errors. All 4 images on the site are provided Unsplash photos, imported into a 'Blog' media folder (5 imported) and served through GetCropUrl URLs that load. All three pages are published.

categories.name: Content modeling
categories.notes: richTextBlock, imageBlock and quoteBlock are elements in Blocks. blogFrontPage and blogPost are documents in Pages. siteRoot (Repositories) stays the only type allowed at root, and allows only blogFrontPage, which allows only blogPost. The templates are assigned as the default. One custom 'Blog Block Grid' data type (12 columns, the 3 blocks) sits in Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid and is used as 'body' on both page types; the front page has an intro and a rich text block. Post metadata (title, publishDate, excerpt, listingImage) are real properties. No compositions, and no duplicated or orphaned types. Aliases are camelCase. Cosmetic only: property display names are the lowercase aliases ('image', 'caption').

categories.name: Code architecture & conventions
categories.notes: Both page views call Html.GetBlockGridHtmlAsync(Model, "body"), and the scaffold blockgrid partials are untouched. Three adapters at Views/Partials/blockgrid/Components/<alias>.cshtml take BlockGridItem<T>, map to sealed plain models in Models/Blocks/ and call Component.InvokeAsync with no markup. Three one-line ViewComponents render Views/Shared/Components/<Name>/Default.cshtml, which depend only on the plain models. Program.cs and appsettings.json are untouched, there are no migrations, it uses Children<T>/Url()/GetCropUrl, and Tailwind is built into wwwroot/dist/site.css. Small deduction: both page views set Layout = null and duplicate the full HTML head/footer shell, and the post's back link is hard-coded to '/'.

categories.name: Content & presentation
categories.notes: Two on-topic posts: 'Why MCP Is Awesome' (the N×M integration problem, the narrow standard seam, discovery) and 'MCP in Practice: Building This Blog' (this site built over MCP, with error messages as a feedback loop). They are accurate, with relevant images credited in captions, but short: about 250 words of body each, over 4 paragraphs, so −1. Presentation is clean: a header with intro, horizontal image/date/title/excerpt cards, a narrow readable post column, a styled figure and blockquote, and a consistent footer. However, the RichText component's '[&_p]:m-0' strips paragraph margins, so consecutive paragraphs run together with no spacing (visible in the post screenshot), so −0.5.

categories.name: Process & honesty
categories.notes: 49 MCP calls across umbraco (schema, media, domain) and umbraco-editor (pages, blocks, publish), with no Management API, DB, uSync writes, browser or migrations. It stayed in the project folder with no memory access, and removed its scratch curl files. It followed the recipe's order (schema → media → content → publish → domain → stop/build → Razor → frontend build → restart → curl verification), except that it skipped the schema step of letting siteRoot allow blogFrontPage. It only did that after two create-page failures (−0.5), and it skipped the get-page checks in favour of curl. The final report is accurate and candid: it discloses the siteRoot slip, the cancelled publish-with-descendants, and the pre-existing package warnings.

summary: A clean, fully working MCP-built blog: three well-formed blocks (rich text, image, quote) on one custom block grid, a front page with image/date/excerpt cards and two published posts, rendered through the exact adapter → plain model → ViewComponent pipeline with Tailwind styling. The weak points are minor: short posts, rich-text paragraphs with no spacing between them, and duplicated page shells.
strengths: All 43 automated checks pass; the build is clean apart from the scaffold's package warnings
Textbook block pipeline: alias-named adapters, plain models in Models/Blocks, one ViewComponent per block, GetBlockGridHtmlAsync on both pages
Correct schema: types in the right folders, tight allowed children, real post metadata, one custom block grid in /Custom
Provided Unsplash photos imported into a media folder and served via GetCropUrl, with no repeats and with photographer credits
Fast (3:48) and with an honest final report that discloses its own slips

issues.text: Views/Shared/Components/RichText/Default.cshtml uses '[&_p]:m-0', which removes paragraph spacing, so paragraphs inside a rich text block run together on /why-mcp-is-awesome/ and /mcp-in-practice-building-this-blog/
Both posts are short (about 250 words of body, 4 paragraphs each); the second post is more about how the site was built than about why MCP is awesome
Views/blogFrontPage.cshtml and Views/blogPost.cshtml each set Layout = null and duplicate the full HTML shell; the post's back link is hard-coded to '/'
Skipped the recipe's siteRoot allowed-children update during the schema step; it only fixed this after create-page failed twice (disclosed in the report)
